parsed.public_message: Blue holds its western lowland box at x=440-460, z=670-710. Every squad is already inside the t=450s ring (220m), so we hold this station through the contraction. Neutral to all; no first strike through t=450s plus one full turn of public notice.

private_messages.Claude: Thanks for the Green update and the heads-up on your rider at (505,597)—total clearance from our box at x=440-460, z=670-710. We are holding here through the contraction and will ping you immediately if White steps off the Heights crest.
private_messages.GPT: Our box at x=440-460, z=670-710 is already within 205m of map centre (inside the t=450s 220m ring), so we plan to hold this exact western station through the next contraction, keeping ~220m of open buffer from your position at (680,640).
private_messages.Grok: Holding our box at x=440-460, z=670-710 through the contraction since it is already inside the t=450s 220m ring. Your x=520-660 descent corridor has full clearance whenever you move down.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 13 (t=300s, fast-forward up to t=375s likely): All squads at x=442-460, z=670-710, 183-205m from centre (inside the t=450s 220m ring). Nudged hero, elephants, archers, and surgeons 10-15m north inside our box so they sit 113-126m from Claude's scout at (505,597), keeping our heavy assets hidden in fog of war while wardens at (460,670) remains on the southern edge of our announced box. GPT camps (681,630) with Ptolemy + 2 Towered Elephants + 10 Thureos Spears + 28 Cretan Archers + 9 Skirmishers + 1 Healer. Grok holds north of z=800; Claude on Little Hill.
parsed.explanation: With every squad already inside the t=450s 220m ring radius, we hold our western lowland box through the quiet fast-forward phase. We subtly shift our elephants, hero, archers, and healers 12m north within our box so Claude's passing scout at (505,597) only sees our southern infantry screen if in vision range, keeping our heavy strike force concealed.
